goal: Automate pull-request review: static analysis, style checks, and a summarized review comment
description: The system reviews each opened pull request, runs static analysis and style checks in parallel, synthesizes findings into a single structured review comment, and escalates risky changes to a human reviewer.
tasks: Detect and classify changed files in a pull request
Run static analysis on modified source files
Synthesize findings into one review comment
Escalate high-risk changes to a human reviewer
